metadata.title: Why SpaceX’s Multi-Billion Dollar Debt Sale Is Already Losing Money for Investors<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Why SpaceX’s Multi-Billion Dollar Debt Sale Is Already Losing Money for Investors
SpaceX’s $25 billion bond deal in late June has proven to be a dud amid apparent investor concern that the company will rely on the debt markets for its massive projected capital spending over the coming years.
